description.text: Study duration 6 years, including 1 year of internship in hospital Application deadline July 31. Main Courses Covers preclinical medicine, clinical medicine and public health. Also covers biology, chemistry, immune system, pharmacy. Requirement on Chinese Language Applicants are required to pass HSK (band 3) before graduation; otherwise they cannot get the degree. Note:The requirement of the level of HSKmay be changed according to the Ministry of Education of P.R.C.. Internship Information

duration.text: The Clinical Medicine at Nanchang University is a 6 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of High school 5. Health certificate Required during application.Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months)

requirements.text: High school graduate or above, or have passed Grade Twelve (10+2)/FSc./A Level/WAEC or equivalent. For non-native English speakers, passing an English test which contains written and oral parts given by NCU. For native English speakers, only passing the oral part of the English test is enough.
